## Mission

Bumps every version site, writes the developer changelog entry, and gets the tag ready. A person pushes the tag and presses publish.

## Surface

Repositories: Vinc, Vinc-homepage

- scripts/version_sync.py
- CHANGELOG.md
- .github/workflows/release.yml
- site/release/

## Read before the first edit, in this order

1. vinc.release.changelog
2. vinc.ops.deployment
3. vinc.plan.code-signing
4. vinc.canon.repo-workflow

## Gates that must pass before the pull request

- scripts/version_sync.py

## Never

- push a tag
- publish a draft release
- edit the changelog with a script

## Only a person does this

- tag push
- publish

## Trap note

ten version sites across six files, and the changelog is deliberately not one of them. A tag without a bump tells every installed client forever that an update is available.
